{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Frost Invader''' is a [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It has a high amount of health and an above average speed. As it is a [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy by default, it will spawn with it majority of the time, meaning it requires lead detection to be killed. ==Logbook Description== "''Frost Invaders move in groups, charging into battle with their hand-forged armor that deflects most attacks. Their capes, crafted from fine Crystal Horn wool, provide additional lightweight protection against ranged units. These high-health units enter the battlefield strategically, waiting until their target has been weakened.''" ==Appearance== The '''Frost Invader''' has blue skin. It wears a grey helmet with blue horns, grey shoulder-pads, grey shoes with grey plates, brown belts with grey buckle, blue pants and shirt, cape made out of Crystal Horn wool and grey gloves. Around its neck, it has blue fur and it also has multiple blue spikes on its shoulder-pads. ==Strategy== *As the '''Frost Invader''' spawns with [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]], towers with lead detection like the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]], [[Turret]] and [[Kingpin]] are required here. **Unit collisions have lead detection by default. This means towers which normally do not have lead detection, like the [[Necromancer]] or most [[Mercenary Base]] units, can damage it through collisions. *The [[Firework Technician]] can be used to give towers which cannot damage it lead detection. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FrostInvader.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseInvader.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FrostModeReworkBanner.png|'''Frost Invader''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Pulse Trooper Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Frost Invader''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvaderIconIG.png|'''Frost Invader''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Frost Invader''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' -
